Configure current feature

  1. Replace the Character’s native movement default subobject with URPGCharacterMovementComponent in C++; do not add a second component in Blueprint.
  2. Keep X/Y movement and Z gravity; remove X/Z plane constraints. Configure capsule34/88, speed450, sprint650, jump420, step35, slope40 as proposals. Map WASD/stick Axis2D relative to fixed camera ground axes, jump, sprint, dodge and swim controls.
  3. Build TerrainLab dry floor,20/40-degree ramps,20/35cm stairs, elevated bridge and true water recess. BP_WaterRegion uses a real swimming physics volume; do not leave a dry blocking floor across its surface.

Run now: current-phase integrated scenarios

  1. Walk a circle using keyboard diagonals and analog stick; normalize keyboard input so diagonal speed does not exceed straight speed.
  2. Sprint, jump, dodge and land at each obstacle; test a low ceiling, ledge and falling threshold. Enter the water from both shores, swim and leave at a walkable exit.
  3. Repeat at30/60/120 client frames per second. Remove PaperZD presentation and repeat physical movement.
Expected success
One capsule follows full3D geometry with no planar lock; bridge and lower path remain distinct.
Stamina/action eligibility uses one injected movement resource interface. The pre-GAS fixture is transient and replaced by ASC attributes at07, not retained as a second stamina owner.

Explicitly not active yet

  1. Latency/prediction proof begins03. Cast/weapon combat begins07. No climbing or mounted movement is introduced.

Expected rejection and concurrency results

SystemStimulus -> expected outcome
current-phase fixtureBlocked dodge endpoint/insufficient budget rejects the action; no teleport through walls or extra jump from repeated presses.
current-phase fixtureMovement intent clears on UI focus loss and controller replacement; held input is not replayed unexpectedly.

Regression, disconnect and restart

  1. Restart the test environment twice; one admitted pawn per account, one local input context installation, no stale widgets.
  2. Repeat the previous phase success case after all new assignments; definitions missing from this phase must fail closed, not fall back to client saves.
  3. Before networking, verify local cleanup but do not label it a multiplayer test.

Stop condition and deferred work

One movement integrator; no X/Z plane constraint or sprite-collision authority.

Stop on a failed required assertion, missing required rule definition, duplicate authority or unverified dependency that this phase relies on. Legal debug art may support physics tests but cannot close the archive/PaperZD art gate. Do not activate future-phase systems merely because their full-game chapter exists.
